hypothesis: Chronological prior-year validation of optimizer budget may reduce training checkpoint selection overfit relative to the same fixed120 models. Allow explicit SOXX null model; improvement from null is not evidence of better learned alpha.
checkpoint_rule: For each seed and cap, original first strict feasible F improvement from exactSOXX F0; original three-seed own-state ensemble training feasibility acceptance. No changes to source architecture, objective, scaler, price basis, costs or risk limits.
inner_validation_signal_years: For yearY, onlyY-2,Y-1, each using its own prior-trained annual source model. Cash start at beginning of each two-year validation path; carry across its year boundary.
validation_maturity: feature_available_at and return_available_at strictly before Jan1Y America/New_York; discard only trailing unmatured rows, fail on missing/interior gaps. Scores forY never readY labels.
selection: Maximize minimum across10/25bp of mean paired daily net logexcess vs same-cost exactSOXX. Null score0. Exact ties select smaller budget. Keep all candidate scores and best learned-cap score. No additional validation threshold, seed search or risk overlay.
evaluation: All streams carry actual holdings2016–2022. Shared2016/17warmup alwaysbudget120. Primary diagnostic2018–2022; full2016–2022 secondary descriptive includes unchangedwarmup. Neither is fresh holdout.
baseline: original frozen120-update annual ensembles, exact checkpoint and fullpath reproduction required

uncertainty.method: paired stationary bootstrap adaptive minus fixed120, reused historical diagnostic only

stopping: One fixed experiment. No cap/window/feature/seed changes after results. Negative result remains evidence; no follow-up grid in this card.
limitations: Historical research selection cannot be undone by purging or nested evaluation.
